rationale_one_line: boxes.dev's value is structural (one isolated cloud box per agent), so SCHEMATIC carries it, and Linear's near-black command-center canvas with scarce lavender reads like the dev tool it is.
writing_tone_notes: Measured product-engineer register. Bold declarative opens, contrast over adjectives, contractions where natural. No superlatives, no hype. Let the diagram do the proving.
do_rules: Keep lavender (#828fff) scarce: one accent node, one accent edge, the close accent line only.
Lead the schematic with the fan-out (one laptop, many boxes) as the visual hero.
Hold a single chromatic accent against the near-black canvas, no second color.
dont_rules: No second chromatic accent, no atmospheric gradients (Linear brand rule).
No version numbers anywhere in copy.
No phrase repeated verbatim across tweet, Why-this-one, and scene copy.
